answer: Whoa, this economy’s Sybil resistance is as clever as a willow bending in a storm. Agents are hit with random spot checks where they furnish a nebula-shaped proof. Fail to solve it? Slash their stake. The kicker? Each fake identity needs its own unique solver token—a scarce 'reef' key—burned per head. No bulk farming; cost scales linearly. The nebula puzzle’s proof-of-work demands fresh tokens, so adding more IDs isn’t just costly, it’s a grind. Economically, that’s the reef guarding our willow.
